tasks.title: Define the build-manifest and build-report contracts
tasks.description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/build-manifest.schema.json (required schema_version/project/tasks; each task requires id + status enum pending|done|skipped, with files array and reason string) and build-report.schema.json (required schema_version/project/generated_at/tasks_total/tasks_done/tasks_skipped/files_touched; counts integer minimum 0; additionalProperties false). Add validateBuildManifest/validateBuildReport to cli/lib/validate.js and register both schema names in REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: Both schemas exist under contracts/schemas/v1 and load via the existing validator.
validateBuildManifest and validateBuildReport are exported and tested (valid + invalid cases).
doctor still passes with both new schema names registered.

tasks.title: Implement appbuilder build init
tasks.description: Create cli/lib/build.js exporting build(cwd, args). Implement the init subcommand: gate on build/<slug>/scaffold-report.json existing, read the compiled task-plan, and write build/<slug>/build-manifest.json with every task pre-listed as status pending (empty files, empty reason). Refuse to overwrite without --force. Wire the router case "build" to build(cwd, args) and update help text. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: build init <slug> writes a schema-valid manifest with one pending entry per plan task.
build init fails clearly when scaffold-report.json is absent.
build init refuses to overwrite an existing manifest without --force.

tasks.title: Implement the appbuilder build validation gate
tasks.description: In cli/lib/build.js, implement the default build(cwd, slug) gate: manifest exists and is schema-valid; manifest ids exactly match task-plan ids; no task pending; each done task lists >=1 file that exists under build/<slug>/; each skipped task has a non-empty reason; scaffold-report rendered_files still exist. On pass, write a schema-valid build/<slug>/build-report.json (counts + sorted files_touched). On failure, print fail build: lines, exit 1, write nothing. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: A fully-done manifest passes and writes a schema-valid build-report.json.
pending tasks, missing declared files, reasonless skips, mismatched ids, and deleted scaffold files each fail the gate with a clear message and no report written.

tasks.title: Document the build phase
tasks.description: Give operators a thorough walkthrough of the build phase in HOWTO.md (both verbs, the build-manifest the agent fills in, the status vocabulary, every failure mode, and where build sits in the loop), update README.md (Build section + loop description), and polish the CLI help text. No code/behavior changes.
acceptance_criteria: HOWTO.md has a dedicated build-phase section as thorough as the scaffold section.
README.md describes build init and build and no longer lists build as a placeholder.
appbuilder help text documents both build verbs.
